title: OpenRouterList models API
description: The stable OpenRouterList projection of current OpenRouter model pricing and capabilities.

schema_version.description: The major schema version; version 1 only receives additive field changes.

updated.description: The UTC time when the source model data last changed, in ISO 8601 format.

source.description: The public OpenRouter models API from which this document is derived.

count.description: The number of entries in models.

models.description: Current models sorted lexicographically by id.

items.description: A deliberately small projection of one OpenRouter model.

id.description: The exact OpenRouter model identifier used in API requests.

name.description: The human-readable model name supplied by OpenRouter.

url.description: The absolute OpenRouterList model-page URL, or null when the id cannot form a safe static path.

prompt_per_1m.description: Prompt-token price in USD per one million tokens, or null for variable or unavailable pricing.

completion_per_1m.description: Completion-token price in USD per one million tokens, or null for variable or unavailable pricing.

pricing.description: Pricing classification: fixed, free, variable router pricing, or unavailable.

context_length.description: Maximum context-window length in tokens, or null when it is unavailable.

capabilities.description: Five capability flags derived consistently from OpenRouter supported_parameters.

tool_calling.description: True when both tools and tool_choice are advertised.

reasoning.description: True when reasoning or include_reasoning is advertised.

input_modalities.description: Input modality names advertised by OpenRouter.

output_modalities.description: Output modality names advertised by OpenRouter.

created.description: The model creation time in UTC ISO 8601 format, or null when unavailable.

expiration_date.description: The retirement date reported by OpenRouter, or null when none is announced.
